title: Summarize a login flow redesign update
prompt: Summarize the following update in one sentence: The mobile app's login flow was redesigned to use biometric authentication by default, reducing average login time from 8 seconds to 2 seconds in early testing.

metadata.notes: Correct: mentions the biometric redesign and the login-time improvement (8s to 2s). Omitting the change entirely is incorrect; omitting only the specific numbers is a minor deduction, not a failure. Graded manually.
